name: timers-and-countdowns
title: Timers and Countdowns
description: Start named countdown timers with natural language and ring when they finish
author: sander_cokart

commands.name: start-timer
commands.title: Start Timer
commands.description: Start a countdown from natural language. Name is optional, in the phrase or as an argument.

commands.name: stop-timer
commands.title: Stop Timer
commands.description: See running timers and stop the one you want.

commands.name: change-ring-sound
commands.title: Change Ring Sound
commands.description: Preview system sounds and choose the one that plays when a timer finishes.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
